title: Funding Affordable Housing & Veteran Care
summary:
*   Approved over $1.2 million in funding for Foundation Communities to develop Garden Terrace Apartments, an 85-unit single-room-occupancy (SRO) facility, boosting affordable housing options.
*   Provided nearly $72,000 to Community Partnership for the Homeless to acquire nine transitional housing units specifically for low-income homeless veterans.
*   Postponed a decision on refinancing up to $9 million in bonds for the Riverchase Apartments, an existing housing facility.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
MINUTES
THURSDAY, JANUARY 10, 2002
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened at 2:25
p.m. on Thursday, January 10, 2002 in the Hancock Building Board Room at the Lower Colorado
River Authority, 3700 Lake Austin Blvd. The following agenda were the AHFC items considered by
the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors.
President Garcia called the meeting to order at 2:25 p.m.
AHFC-1. 
Approval of minutes for Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
December 13,2001.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
December 13, 2001 were approved on Vice President Goodman's motion, Board
Member Griffith's second by a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-2. 
Approve the issuance of Austin Housing Finance Corporation Refunding Multi-family
non-recourse bonds in an amount not to exceed an aggregate principal amount of $9
million and the financing documents in connection with the transaction to refinance the
bonds issued in 1985 on the Riverchase Apartments, owned and operated by Riverchase
Associates, Ltd., a Texas limited partnership.
The motion to postpone this item to January 17, 2002 was approved on Board
Member Griffith's motion, Board Member Slusher's second by a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-3. 
Approve a Resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a Rental Housing
Development Assistance (RHDA) Program loan in an amount not to exceed $1,275,750 to
Garden Terrace Housing Corporation, an affiliate of Foundation Communities, for the
acquisition and development of the Garden Terrace Apartments, an 85-unit single-room-
occupancy (SRO) rental facility at 1015 West William Cannon Drive.
Resolution No. 020110-3 was approved on Vice President Goodman's motion, Board
Member Griffith's second by a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-4. 
Approve a Resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a Rental Housing
Development Assistance (RHDA) program payment loan in an amount not to exceed
$71,900 to Community Partnership for the Homeless for the acquisition of nine units of
transitional housing for low income homeless veterans.
Resolution No. 020110-4 was approved on Vice President Goodman's motion, Board
Member Alvarez' second by a 7-0 vote.
